edit.statement: 'Founded' is inverse functional: a state, city or institution was founded by at most one person, so two founders of the same thing are the same person.
edit.subject: founded
edit.original: 'Founded' is not inverse functional: a state, city or institution can have several founders.
edit.scope: Founding of states, cities, orders and institutions by persons; what each person founded is otherwise untouched.
